description: This source file defines a ParserEventLog class extending AbstractParser to parse event log data. It implements methods for obtaining trace type, magic number, decoding trace buffers into Event objects, and processing decoded entries. The class is tailored to handle event logs identified by the 'EventLog' magic number.
